utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Ira, what exactly still needs fixing for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the fence by the corner lot and a few loose porch steps. I also heard one of the volunteers is bringing tools this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—I'll make sure we have enough hands for the fence and steps. Do you know what time the tools are coming?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, thanks Gus — that’d really help. I’ll let you know what tools we’re still missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Noah. I’m happy to help fill in any gaps once you know what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are already pitching in, and it sounds like a nice little neighborhood effort. If you want, I can tell you what I’ve heard so far.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d be helpful—do you know what they still need and where we’re supposed to bring things?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ve heard they still need tools, screws, and a few basic supplies, and people are dropping them off at the community center by the front desk. I can check if there’s a full list posted there too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Sam — could you please check the garage and back shed for any extra tools or spare parts we can bring by?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’ll check the garage and back shed for any extra tools or spare parts and bring by whatever I find.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard about the repair drive—count me in, and I can pass the word along to a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Quinn. That really helps more than you know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Glad to help—I'll let a few folks know today and see who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. Let me know if you need a hand with anything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — I may take you up on that. I’ll send out the details once I’ve got everything lined up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you remind me of the details for the repair drive? I want to make sure I’ve got it right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah — it’s the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday, mostly for small fixes like leaky faucets, loose steps, and broken outlets. I’m pretty sure it starts in the morning at the community center, but I’d double-check the flyer for the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — I’ve got the Saturday repair drive and the community center, but I’ll check the flyer for the exact start time before I go.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Mara, I’m trying to see what time the repair drive lines up with school pickup. Do you know the schedule yet?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I don’t have the schedule yet, sorry, but I can check and let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive's getting some good momentum. Do you know what they still need most?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly volunteers with tools and a few extra supplies — folks seem eager, but they could still use more hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that makes sense. I can spread the word and see if anyone nearby has tools to lend.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what you’re collecting for and when you need it by?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m collecting for the repair drive itself, and I need everything by Friday if that works.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out if you need me to. What still needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, thanks, Rey — I think the fence gate and that loose porch step still need a look. I’m a bit forgetful, but I’d really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can take a look at the gate and the porch step. Just point me to them when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure people know when it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik — I’ll keep track of supplies and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll keep reminding folks about the repair drive and send them your way if they have supplies to donate.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard the repair drive is picking up some good donations—what’s still needed?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mostly tools and a few spare parts still. If you hear of any extra wire or sealant, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an eye out for wire or sealant when I’m out running errands. If I spot any tools too, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit fuzzy, but I’m happy to help; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren—could you spread the word and remind people to drop off any broken small appliances or tools this Saturday? I’ll handle sorting and the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I can do that. I’ll remind folks to bring broken small appliances or tools this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m a bit behind, but I can help if there’s something I should be doing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks for the reminder—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand. What tools do you need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Gus. I’ll bring the wrench, screwdriver, and a flashlight, and I’ll meet you by the garage at 9.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Eli — I’ll meet you by the garage at 9. Thanks for bringing the tools.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — could you help me spread the word and maybe bring a few supplies if you can? I’ll send out the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I can spread the word and I’ll bring a few supplies if I can. Just send me the details when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m happy to help however I can with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you help by checking which houses still need pickup and where we should start?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can do a quick check and map out the houses that still need pickup, then we can start with the closest ones.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ve got the repair drive details organized, and I’m happy to help however I can. What do you need from me first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rosa — can you tell me what supplies are still needed most, and where I should drop them off?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The biggest needs are basic tools, tape, batteries, and cleaning supplies. You can drop everything off at the community center front desk, and I’ll make sure it gets sorted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a lot of support already. If you know what still needs doing, I’d love an update.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Do we still need volunteers for sorting donations, or is that covered now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not totally sure yet, but I can check on the latest update and get back to you. If sorting is still open, I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, what do we still need for the repair drive? I’ve only got a minute, so give me the quick version.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: We still need a few more tools, some screws and nails, and a couple volunteers for pickup and sorting. I can text the school schedule once I’m done dropping off the kids.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I can grab screws and nails. Text me the school schedule when you can, and I’ll see about pickup.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep, it’s still happening. I’m helping keep it on track.
